scanNote:
WORKBOOK 14-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (58-bet, PDF 56). Yuqorida to'q sariq yorliqda 'UNIT 14', yonida katta qora 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Vocabulary':
1a) 'Look at the pictures and label the parts of the animals with the words below.' Qiya: 'beak, ear, head, leg, neck, nose, tail, teeth, tongue, wing'. RASM (jirafa, to'tiqush, sher): 1 jirafa boshi (head); 2 to'tiqush burni (nose - tumshuq ustidagi teshiklar); 3 jirafa bo'yni (neck); 4 to'tiqush qanoti (wing); 5 to'tiqush tumshug'i (beak); 6 jirafa oyog'i (leg); 7 to'tiqush dumi (tail); 8 sher qulog'i (ear); 9 sher tili (tongue); 10 sher tishlari (teeth).
1b) 'Which of these words do we use for parts of the human body?'
2) 'Write the words in the correct boxes. Which of the animals are endangered species?' Qiya: 'bee, salmon, parrot, cow, lion, eagle, snake, ant, dolphin, chicken, tuna, alligator, shark, butterfly, lizard'. DIAGRAMMA 'The Animal Kingdom': MAMMALS, FISH, REPTILES, BIRDS, INSECTS (har birida 3 qator).

O'NG USTUN:
3a) 'Label the pictures with words from the list, then match the animals to the notes.' Qiya: 'cheetah, crocodile, elephant, emu, shark'. 5 SURAT: A fil; B gepard (yugurayotgan); C emu (qush); D akula; E timsoh. JADVAL: 1 ...... spots, long tail, sharp teeth; can run very fast. 2 ...... long legs, small wings; a bird - but can't fly. 3 ...... thick skin, ivory tusks; can pick things up with trunk. 4 ...... long tail, sharp teeth, thick skin; lives on land & in water. 5 ...... sharp teeth, pointed fins, muscular tail; can swim very fast.
3b) 'Use the notes to talk about each animal, as in the example.' Qiya namuna: 'A cheetah has got spots, a long tail and sharp teeth. It can run very fast.'
4) 'Fill in the gaps with words from the list.' Qiya: 'captivity, companion, danger, pets, protected, survival'. 1 These animals are now in ...... of becoming extinct. 2 I don't think that parrots and monkeys should be sold as ...... . 3 Rhinos need to be ...... from hunters, who kill them for their horns. 4 I believe that it's wrong to keep wild animals in ...... . 5 We must help endangered species so they have a better chance of ...... . 6 A cat or a dog can make a good ...... for children or the elderly.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '58'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and label the parts of the animals with the words below: beak, ear, head, leg, neck, nose, tail, teeth, tongue, wing.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va hayvonlar a'zolarini quyidagi so'zlar bilan nomlang: beak, ear, head, leg, neck, nose, tail, teeth, tongue, wing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAYVON A'ZOLARI (coursebook
  98-bet).

  JIRAFA: 1 head, 3 neck (uzun
    bo'yin!), 6 leg
  TO'TIQUSh: 2 nose (tumshuq
    ustidagi teshiklar), 4 wing,
    5 beak, 7 tail
  ShER: 8 ear, 9 tongue, 10 teeth


⚠ 'A BEAK':

  = tumshuq (qush).


⚠ 'A WING':

  = qanot.


⚠ 'TEETH':

  = tishlar (tooth ning ko'pligi).


⚠ 'TONGUE':

  = til. /tʌŋ/ - 'ue' o'qilmaydi.

items.en: Which of these words do we use for parts of the human body?
items.answerEn: ear, head, leg, neck, nose, teeth and tongue. (Beak, tail and wing are only for animals.)
items.answerUz: ear, head, leg, neck, nose, teeth va tongue. (Beak, tail va wing - faqat hayvonlar uchun.)

exercises.instructionEn: Write the words in the correct boxes: bee, salmon, parrot, cow, lion, eagle, snake, ant, dolphin, chicken, tuna, alligator, shark, butterfly, lizard. Boxes: MAMMALS, FISH, REPTILES, BIRDS, INSECTS. Which of the animals are endangered species?
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni to'g'ri kataklarga yozing: bee, salmon, parrot, cow, lion, eagle, snake, ant, dolphin, chicken, tuna, alligator, shark, butterfly, lizard. Kataklar: SUTEMIZUVChILAR, BALIQLAR, SUDRALIB YURUVChILAR, QUShLAR, HAShAROTLAR. Qaysi hayvonlar xavf ostidagi turlar?
exercises.explanationUz:
HAYVONOT DUNYOSI - 5 GURUH.

  MAMMALS (sutemizuvchilar): cow,
    lion, dolphin
  FISH (baliqlar): salmon, tuna,
    shark
  REPTILES (sudralib yuruvchilar):
    snake, alligator, lizard
  BIRDS (qushlar): parrot, eagle,
    chicken
  INSECTS (hasharotlar): bee, ant,
    butterfly

  ⚠ DELFIN - BALIQ EMAS,
  sutemizuvchi!


⚠ XAVF OSTIDAGI TURLAR:

  lion, eagle, dolphin, tuna,
  alligator, shark, parrot -
  ba'zi turlari xavf ostida.


⚠ 'A REPTILE':

  = sudralib yuruvchi.


⚠ 'SALMON':

  = losos. /ˈsæmən/ - 'l'
  O'QILMAYDI.

5 HAYVON:
  A elephant - fil
  B cheetah - gepard
  C emu - emu (avstraliyalik

exercises.instructionUz: Hayvonlarni qaydlarga moslang. 1 dog'lar, uzun dum, o'tkir tishlar; juda tez yuguradi. 2 uzun oyoqlar, kichik qanotlar; qush - lekin ucha olmaydi. 3 qalin teri, fil suyagi tishlari; xartumi bilan narsalarni ko'tara oladi. 4 uzun dum, o'tkir tishlar, qalin teri; quruqlikda va suvda yashaydi. 5 o'tkir tishlar, uchli suzgichlar, mushakli dum; juda tez suzadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR → HAYVON:

  1 spots, run fast → CHEETAH
  2 bird, can't fly → EMU
  3 tusks, trunk → ELEPHANT
  4 land & water → CROCODILE
  5 fins, swim fast → SHARK


⚠ 'IVORY TUSKS':

  = fil suyagi tishlari (157-
  betdagi Photo File eslang).


⚠ 'A TRUNK':

  = xartum.


⚠ 'FINS':

  = suzgichlar.


⚠ 'MUSCULAR':

  = mushakli, kuchli.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes to talk about each animal, as in the example: A cheetah has got spots, a long tail and sharp teeth. It can run very fast.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlar bilan har bir hayvon haqida gapiring, namunadagidek: Gepardning dog'lari, uzun dumi va o'tkir tishlari bor. U juda tez yugura oladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIP:
  A/An + HAYVON has got + A'ZOLAR.
  It can/can't + FE'L.

  ⚠ 'has got' - egalik; 'can' -
  qobiliyat.
  ⚠ 'AN emu', 'AN elephant' - unli.
exercises.exampleEn: A cheetah has got spots, a long tail and sharp teeth. It can run very fast.
exercises.exampleUz: Gepardning dog'lari, uzun dumi va o'tkir tishlari bor. U juda tez yugura oladi.
modelAnswers: An emu has got long legs and small wings. It is a bird, but it can't fly.
An elephant has got thick skin and ivory tusks. It can pick things up with its trunk.
A crocodile has got a long tail, sharp teeth and thick skin. It lives on land and in water.
A shark has got sharp teeth, pointed fins and a muscular tail. It can swim very fast.
modelAnswersUz: Emuning uzun oyoqlari va kichik qanotlari bor. U qush, lekin ucha olmaydi.
Filning qalin terisi va fil suyagi tishlari bor. U xartumi bilan narsalarni ko'tara oladi.
Timsohning uzun dumi, o'tkir tishlari va qalin terisi bor. U quruqlikda va suvda yashaydi.
Akulaning o'tkir tishlari, uchli suzgichlari va mushakli dumi bor. U juda tez suza oladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with words from the list: captivity, companion, danger, pets, protected, survival.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan to'ldiring: captivity, companion, danger, pets, protected, survival.
exercises.explanationUz:
XAVF OSTIDAGI TURLAR LUG'ATI
  (coursebook 99-bet 5-mashq).

  in DANGER of becoming extinct -
    yo'qolib ketish xavfida
  sold as PETS - uy hayvoni
    sifatida sotilmoq
  PROTECTED from hunters -
    ovchilardan himoyalangan
  in CAPTIVITY - qafasda, asirlikda
  chance of SURVIVAL - omon qolish
    imkoni
  a good COMPANION - yaxshi hamroh


⚠ 'CAPTIVITY':

  = asirlik (hayvonot bog'i,
  qafas). 'in the wild' - tabiatda.


⚠ 'RHINOS':

  = karkidonlar (rhinoceros).
  'horns' = shoxlar.


⚠ 'THE ELDERLY':

  = keksalar ('the' + sifat).

items.sentence: These animals are now in ___ of becoming extinct.
items.uz: Bu hayvonlar endi yo'qolib ketish xavfida.

items.sentence: I don't think that parrots and monkeys should be sold as ___ .
items.uz: Menimcha, to'tiqush va maymunlar uy hayvoni sifatida sotilmasligi kerak.

items.sentence: Rhinos need to be ___ from hunters, who kill them for their horns.
items.uz: Karkidonlarni shoxlari uchun o'ldiradigan ovchilardan himoya qilish kerak.

items.sentence: I believe that it's wrong to keep wild animals in ___ .
items.uz: Yovvoyi hayvonlarni qafasda saqlash noto'g'ri deb hisoblayman.

items.sentence: We must help endangered species so they have a better chance of ___ .
items.uz: Xavf ostidagi turlarga yordam berishimiz kerak, shunda ularning omon qolish imkoni ko'proq bo'ladi.

items.sentence: A cat or a dog can make a good ___ for children or the elderly.
items.uz: Mushuk yoki it bolalar yoki keksalar uchun yaxshi hamroh bo'la oladi.

patterns.formula: A/An + HAYVON has got + A'ZOLAR. It can + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: A cheetah has got spots and a long tail. It can run very fast.
patterns.exampleUz: Gepardning dog'lari va uzun dumi bor. U juda tez yugura oladi.

patterns.formula: X is a bird, but it can't fly.
patterns.exampleEn: An emu is a bird, but it can't fly.

patterns.formula: X is in danger of becoming extinct.
patterns.exampleEn: These animals are now in danger of becoming extinct.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu hayvonlar endi yo'qolib ketish xavfida.

patterns.formula: X needs to be protected from Y.
patterns.exampleEn: Rhinos need to be protected from hunters.
